note: MDC access on the Middle Fabius River. The primitive camping area is a short gravel spur of its own, about 50 m long, that leaves the access road just before the river parking lot and ends in a small turnaround under bottomland timber; no built pads, tables, toilets or water. The river is about 60 m off through the trees, and MDC says the concrete boat ramp is inaccessible. Low river-bottom ground that floods. Gravel county road in. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC designates a primitive camping area on its own spur (map symbol + GIS point), not the lot - stays. Phone matches. Free/FCFS/14 nights/no hookups confirmed. Not waterfront stands. Pin 13 m off the gravel (minor).
flags: LOT RULE - STAYS: the page lists 'Designated Camping Sites' and 'Individual Campsites'; the 06/07 map legend has 'Primitive Camping Area' and draws the symbol at the end of a short gravel spur north-west of the river Parking Lot (apart from the lot and the Boat Ramp symbol); GIS layer 27 has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point at 40.05536,-91.73140, 91 m from the river lot's GIS point. Imagery (0.2 m/px) shows the spur: about 4 m wide and 50 m long, leaving the access road 60 m north of the lot and curling south-west under the trees to a small turnaround. Nothing built is visible (no pads, rings, tables, privy). No brochure PDF on the page. A second lot sits 890 m east on the entrance road (no camping symbol).
PIN (minor): the GIS point 40.05536,-91.73140 is under canopy about 13 m west of the visible gravel; 40.05533,-91.73125 is on the spur. Not worth a move on its own.

RIVER NAME: the page and map say Middle Fabius River (not North Fabius). Stored not waterfront stands: the spur's turnaround is about 60 m from the channel (15-20 m wide, sandbars) through closed bottomland timber, nothing seen of it leaf-on.

ACCESS / FLOODING: 1.4 km of gravel (Hawthorne / County Road 508 / 236th) from Route BB; no ford or low-water crossing seen on imagery, no posted limit, no 4WD wording. The page says 'The concrete boat ramp is inaccessible.' The camping spur is on the river bottom at about the level of the lot and will flood with the river; no closure posted on the page now.
PHONE: stored 573-248-2530 matches the page's 'For more information call (573) 248-2530'.
Nothing else in the database within 3 km. No split (one camping point).
